scope.purpose: Combined completeness/current-norm audit of compact Grade-10 spelling/function contrasts; no physical bank mutation.

current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — current search/reference: навстречу / на встречу
Gramota.ru — academic service-word spelling: итак / и так
Gramota.ru — answer 312957: итак / и так function and punctuation
Gramota.ru — academic/reference rule: не кто иной, как / никто иной

current_model.навстречу: solid adverb/preposition in directional meaning, commonly governing dative
current_model.на встречу: separate only when ВСТРЕЧА is an independent noun in a preposition+noun phrase

decisions.patch_policy: Keep contextual noun test; do not choose spelling from the surface sequence alone.

current_model.наподобие: solid preposition meaning вроде / в виде
current_model.на подобие: possible only when ПОДОБИЕ functions as an independent noun in the sentence

decisions.learner_policy: Do not invent a fake stock phrase for the rare separate construction; require a real noun role in context.

current_model.итак: solid when marking conclusion/transition; followed by comma in the standard discourse-marker use
current_model.и так: separate when И + ТАК retain independent function, including meaning и без того

decisions.classification_note: Current reference traditions vary between labeling ИТАК a conjunction and an introductory/discourse word; the learner unit correctly tests function, spelling and punctuation rather than forcing one universal part-of-speech label.

decisions.learner_policy: Select НЕ/НИ from the meaning of the whole construction, not a local mechanical cue.

decisions.punctuation_note: The identification construction takes a comma before КАК.
decisions.patch_policy: Existing unit is exact; extend learner examples across oblique cases without creating new identities.

cumulative_audit_progress.note: Audit counters only; not readiness percentages.
